purpose: Persistent bridge between legacy governed Week 2 IDs and canonical ESPN Weekly Board IDs. Derived datasets must resolve through this bridge rather than string-matching team names.

mappings.note: Legacy ID encodes Kansas/Missouri ordering; canonical schedule identity is Missouri at Kansas.

unresolvedPolicy: No legacy record is considered canonically joined until an explicit mapping is present. Continue expanding this bridge for every legacy 2026-W2-* ID encountered in derived datasets.
